note: The AffrescoUI Studio: the person's client for a running host. Layout, behaviour and the connection are all in this file, its texts in studio-strings.json (English, Italian, Arabic). Ask and direct changes on the left; on the right, tabs for the review queue, the history of main, the approval rules, the permissions (edits become changes to review), an inspector of the connected app and the agents. Below 900 pixels the two sides become panes. Cmd+Shift+P lists every command.

computed.evidence: {{state.evidence != null && computed.current != null && state.evidence.proposal == computed.current.id ? state.evidence : null}}
computed.diffs: {{computed.evidence == null ? [] : map(computed.evidence.texts, {type: 'diff', node: it.node, original: it.original, modified: it.modified, mode: 'split', language: it.language})}}
computed.tabs: {{concat([{id: 'review', label: t('tab.review', {n: length(state.proposals)}), closable: false}, {id: 'history', label: t('tab.history'), closable: false}, {id: 'rules', label: t('tab.rules', {n: length(state.grants)}), closable: false}, {id: 'permissions', label: t('tab.permissions'), closable: false}, {id: 'inspector', label: t('tab.inspector'), closable: false}], empty(state.coordination.peers) ? [] : [{id: 'agents', label: t('tab.agents', {n: length(state.coordination.peers)}), closable: false}])}}
computed.commandItems: {{map(filter(commands, it.enabled && it.name != 'showCommands'), {title: t('cmd.' + it.name), detail: t('cat.' + it.category) + (empty(it.keyLabel ?? '') ? '' : '  ·  ' + it.keyLabel), run: it.name})}}
computed.permValue: {{state.permSection == 'budgets' ? (computed.perm.budgets ?? []) : (state.permSection == 'data' ? (computed.perm.data ?? []) : (state.permSection == 'roles' ? {reviewers: computed.perm.reviewers ?? [], review: computed.perm.review ?? {}, roles: state.coordination.roles ?? {}} : {allow: computed.perm.allow ?? [], ask: computed.perm.ask ?? [], deny: computed.perm.deny ?? []}))}}
computed.permSections: {{map(['rules', 'budgets', 'data', 'roles'], {id: it, label: t('perm.section', {section: it}), closable: false})}}
computed.prTabs: {{computed.current == null ? [] : [{id: 'conversation', label: t('pr.conversation'), closable: false}, {id: 'commits', label: t('pr.commits', {n: computed.current.commits}), closable: false}, {id: 'checks', label: t('pr.checks', {n: computed.evidence == null ? 0 : length(computed.evidence.scenarios)}), closable: false}, {id: 'files', label: t('pr.files', {n: length(computed.current.touches)}), closable: false}]}}
computed.prStale: {{computed.current == null || state.prDiff == null || state.prDiff.for != computed.current.id + ':' + computed.current.head}}
computed.prFiles: {{computed.prAfter == null ? [] : map(computed.current.touches, {path: it, d: diffLines(atPointer(state.hostDocument, it) == null ? '' : formatJson(atPointer(state.hostDocument, it), 2), atPointer(computed.prAfter, it) == null ? '' : formatJson(atPointer(computed.prAfter, it), 2), {context: contains(state.diffExpanded, it) ? -1 : 3, ignoreWhitespace: state.diffWs, split: state.diffSplit})})}}
computed.prTimeline: {{computed.current == null ? [] : concat([{icon: 'git-commit-horizontal', text: t('pr.pushed', {author: computed.current.author, n: computed.current.commits, short: computed.current.short})}], map(computed.current.approvals ?? [], {icon: 'check', text: t('pr.approved', {who: it})}), map(filter(state.reviews, it.proposal == computed.current.id), {icon: it.kind == 'changes' ? 'file-pen-line' : 'message-square', text: t('pr.reviewed', {who: it.author, kind: it.kind, text: it.text})}), empty(computed.current.policy ?? '') ? [] : [{icon: 'shield', text: t('pr.needs', {policy: computed.current.policy})}], computed.current.id == state.previewing ? [{icon: 'eye', text: t('pr.previewed')}] : [])}}
computed.hStale: {{computed.entry == null || state.historyDiff == null || state.historyDiff.for != computed.entry.number + ':' + state.revision}}
computed.hAfter: {{computed.hBefore == null || state.historyDiff.commit == null ? null : applyPatch(computed.hBefore, state.historyDiff.commit)}}
computed.hAreas: {{computed.hAfter == null ? [] : map(map(state.historyDiff.commit, split(it.path, '/')), it[1] == 'root' && length(it) > 3 ? '/' + join(slice(it, 1, 4), '/') : '/' + it[1])}}
computed.hFiles: {{map(filter(computed.hAreas, indexOf(computed.hAreas, it) == index), {path: it, d: diffLines(atPointer(computed.hBefore, it) == null ? '' : formatJson(atPointer(computed.hBefore, it), 2), atPointer(computed.hAfter, it) == null ? '' : formatJson(atPointer(computed.hAfter, it), 2), {context: contains(state.diffExpanded, it) ? -1 : 3, ignoreWhitespace: state.diffWs, split: state.diffSplit})})}}
computed.prChanges: {{computed.current == null ? [] : map(filter(filter(state.reviews, it.proposal == computed.current.id && it.head == computed.current.head), it.kind == 'changes'), it.author)}}
computed.prReviewers: {{computed.current == null ? [] : concat(map(computed.current.approvals ?? [], {who: it, state: 'approved'}), map(filter(state.reviews, it.proposal == computed.current.id && it.head == computed.current.head), {who: it.author, state: it.kind}))}}

listRow.note: A full-width line of a list, its text at the start

applyPatch.note: A JSON Patch [...] or compact edits {"set": {...}}, as typed

then.data: {{merge({ type: 'revision', message: 'Direct change from the Studio' }, parseJson(state.patch))}}

notify.note: with: message. A toast in the corner for a few seconds

toggleInspector.note: The host's debug overlay: the panel under the pointer, frame statistics and an event trace

accept.note: with: always. Accepts the chosen proposal at the head that was reviewed. Never one's own: every path (button, key, palette, a run step) comes here, and the host refuses it too

askHistory.note: with: kind, revert or restore. Asks before changing main

host:evidence.to: {{merge({proposal: event.proposal, scale: event.scale}, {region: event.evidence.region, behaviour: event.evidence.behaviour, scenarios: event.evidence.scenarios, texts: event.evidence.texts ?? [], before: event.evidence.before.data, after: event.evidence.after.data})}}

host:error.note: A send while offline is already shown by the toolbar; a repeated line is shown once

logLine.note: with: kind, key, params. One activity line: its text now, and its key to translate it later

showTab.note: with: tab. The permissions page starts its draft from the current value

addConnection.note: Checks the address, then adds it to the known connections; the token stays in memory

removeConnection.note: with: id. The local one stays; removing the active one goes back to it

switchConnection.note: with: id. Connects the host channel to that address; one connection at a time

to.name: {{(empty(find(state.connections, it.id == id).name) ? t('conn.local') : find(state.connections, it.id == id).name)}}

params.name: {{(empty(find(state.connections, it.id == id).name) ? t('conn.local') : find(state.connections, it.id == id).name)}}

openChild.note: with: index. Goes into a child of the inspected node

pickPermSection.note: with: section. Shows a section; the draft starts as its current value

proposePermissions.note: The draft becomes a change waiting for a reviewer: the Studio never applies it, and no revision can change permissions

sendRequest.title: Send the request to the AI

inspectApp.title: Inspect the app under the pointer

prTab.note: A page of the proposal; Files changed asks the host for its patch

requestHistoryDiff.note: Two diffs make a commit's changes: HEAD to its parent gives the document before it, its parent to it the commit

requestHistoryDiff.if: {{state.tab == 'history' && state.hostDocument != null && computed.entry != null && computed.entry.number > 0 && computed.hStale}}

submitReview.note: Sends the review box: an approval accepts and merges; a comment or a change request goes to the agents as a request, never as an approval

do.note: Sets the draft aside, as a stash does, until it is restored
A proposal against main: its Files changed page

children.text: {{find(state.connections, it.id == state.active) == null ? '' : (empty(find(state.connections, it.id == state.active).name) ? t('conn.local') : find(state.connections, it.id == state.active).name)}}

children.label: {{t('a11y.panes')}}
children.tabs: {{[{id: 'compose', label: t('pane.compose'), closable: false}, {id: 'review', label: t('pane.review') + (length(state.proposals) > 0 ? ' (' + length(state.proposals) + ')' : ''), closable: false}]}}

children.label: {{t('a11y.side')}}
children.tabs: {{[{id: 'review', label: t('side.changes', {n: length(state.proposals)}), closable: false}, {id: 'history', label: t('side.history'), closable: false}]}}

children.items: {{map(state.proposals, {id: text(it.id), label: it.message, icon: 'git-pull-request-arrow', detail: t('review.row', {id: it.id, author: it.author, date: formatDate(it.time * 1000, 'medium', 'utc'), conflicts: empty(it.conflicts ?? []) ? 'no' : 'yes'})})}}
children.label: {{t('a11y.proposals')}}

children.items: {{map(reverse(state.history), {id: text(it.number), label: it.message, icon: length(it.parents ?? []) > 1 ? 'git-merge' : 'git-commit-horizontal', detail: t('history.row', {author: it.author, date: formatDate((it.time ?? 0) * 1000, 'medium', 'utc'), short: it.short, approved: it.committer != it.author ? 'yes' : 'no', committer: it.committer})})}}
children.label: {{t('a11y.history')}}

children.note: A proposal's evidence (VERSION_CONTROL.md): drawn and played by the host, never supplied by its author

children.label: {{t('review.after', {changed: computed.evidence.region[2] == 0 ? 'no' : 'yes', w: computed.evidence.region[2], h: computed.evidence.region[3], x: computed.evidence.region[0], y: computed.evidence.region[1]})}}

children.text: {{t('review.after', {changed: computed.evidence.region[2] == 0 ? 'no' : 'yes', w: computed.evidence.region[2], h: computed.evidence.region[3], x: computed.evidence.region[0], y: computed.evidence.region[1]})}}

children.note: A text the proposal changes, split: the data is 8.4c's diff view ({type: 'diff', original, modified, mode, language}), drawn with two labels until that node type exists
Add a review: a comment or a change request goes to the agents; an approval merges
The reviewers sidebar: who approved or asked for changes, and what the policy needs
A conflicted proposal: per conflict, main's value and the proposal's, side by side
The merge box: whether the chosen proposal can merge, what it needs, and the merge button

children.text: {{computed.mergeState == 'changes' ? t('review.changesBy', {who: join(computed.prChanges, ', ')}) : (computed.mergeState == 'failing' ? t('review.failing', {n: computed.prFailing, total: length(computed.evidence.scenarios)}) : t('review.mergeNeeds', {policy: computed.current.policy ?? '', n: length(computed.current.approvals ?? [])}))}}

{{t('history.entry', {number: computed.entry.number, short: computed.entry.short, approved: computed.entry.committer != computed.entry.author ? 'yes' : 'no', committer: computed.entry.committer, current: computed.entry.number == state.revision ? 'yes' : 'no'})}}
{{t('history.parents', {n: length(computed.entry.parents ?? []), parents: join(map(computed.entry.parents ?? [], slice(it, 0, 7)), ', '), proposal: computed.entry.proposal ?? 'none'})}}

{{computed.entry.number == 0 ? t('history.first') : computed.hAfter != null ? t('history.files', {n: length(computed.hFiles)}) : computed.hStale || state.historyDiff.base == null || state.historyDiff.commit == null ? t('history.loading') : t('history.unshown')}}

children.label: {{t('perm.item', {id: p.id, section: t('perm.section', {section: p.section}), author: p.author})}}

children.text: {{t('perm.item', {id: p.id, section: t('perm.section', {section: p.section}), author: p.author})}}
{{t('insp.blamed', {revision: state.blame.number, short: state.blame.short, author: state.blame.author, message: state.blame.message})}}
{{t('agents.work', {open: count(state.proposals, it.author == p.author), conflicts: count(state.proposals, it.author == p.author && !empty(it.conflicts))})}}

children.items: {{map(state.connections, {id: it.id, label: (empty(it.name) ? t('conn.local') : it.name) + '  ·  ' + it.address, icon: 'database'})}}
children.label: {{t('toolbar.repos')}}

children.items: {{map(computed.branchRows, {id: text(it.id), label: t('toolbar.proposal', {branch: it.branch ?? 'proposal/' + it.id, message: it.message}), icon: 'git-pull-request'})}}
children.label: {{t('toolbar.branches')}}

node.height: {{(contains(state.diffCollapsed, file.path) || (review && contains(state.viewed, file.path))) ? 36 : 36 + sum(map(file.d.hunks, 20 + (state.diffSplit ? length(it.rows) : length(it.lines)) * 18))}}

children.color: {{b < ((file.d.added + file.d.removed) < 5 ? file.d.added : round(5 * file.d.added / (file.d.added + file.d.removed))) ? '@color.good' : (b < ((file.d.added + file.d.removed) < 5 ? (file.d.added + file.d.removed) : 5) ? '@color.bad' : '@color.neutral')}}
